title.narrative: Sustaining the achievement of Peace building in Cyangungu Diocese

description.narrative: In 2013, the Justice and Peace Commission, in partnership with Cafod, launched a sub-regional project aimed at consolidating fraternal and good-neighborhood relations for the peoples living in bordering towns in the Great Lakes sub-region. This is otherwise known as the "Sustainability Project" of the Peace building project that aimed at drawing the people together, the people of the bordering dioceses of Cyangugu (Rwanda), Bukavu and Uvira (DRC) and Bubanza (Burundi)." This project has provided a framework for collaboration and mutual dialogue between the people of the project area. At the end of the project, they now condemn feelings of hatred, mistrust, tension etc and are actively engaged in cross-border rapprochement initiatives for peace and reconciliation. This project leaves behind lots of success requiring a much more thoughtful strategy to strengthen sustainability on the ground. This project comes-in handy to support and pave the way for community defined mechanisms for Peace-building self-supported initiatives. The project will be line-up for 6 months with activities to build the community's stronger ownership of the results achieved. By the end of this project, we endeavor to have created an operational and permanent community based monitoring network of peace building actions between the parishes that have been part of the project. The regular connection and a permanent framework of collaboration between the parishes bordering the targeted dioceses will be maintained even after the project (joint and bilateral participation in events, twinning continued, permanent sharing of information) This will be done through the commitment of the structures set up in the parishes finally to continue the rapprochement as did the CDJP through the project that is coming to an end. This will have the effect of maintaining the attitudes of the cross-border population to resist prejudices and overcome any divisions that may arise from one moment to the next.
